results.title: Tata Steel joins UK–India circular materials research programme
results.description: Tata Steel has joined Britain's new circular materials research partnership. The three-year UK–India programme is expected to support up to 15 grants worth £100,000–£150,000, with projects beginning in April 2027. results.title: Tsang Yow's semiconductor revenue share reaches 12%
results.description: Automotive drivetrain manufacturer Tsang Yow reported consolidated revenue of NT$86.36 million (US$2.69 million) in September 2026, down 2.3% month-over-month and 1.24% year-over-year as demand from the Americas aftermarket temporarily slowed. Supported by its semiconductor business, consolidated revenue reached NT$269 million in the third quarter of 2026, up 7.5% year-over-year, while revenue for the first nine months rose 4.04% year-over-year to NT$824 million.
